title: Grateful Dead Live at San Diego Sports Arena on 1973-11-14

ai_review.summary: High‑energy soundboard capture featuring a wild Truckin’ → The Other One jam, killer Eyes, and an unforgettable Wharf Rat coda.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers give the tape five stars, praising the seamless transitions from Truckin' into a trippy other‑one saga, the tight bass‑heavy groove, and the soaring Eyes performance.  No recording flaws are mentioned, and the soundboard source is regarded as clear enough to enjoy every nuance of the improvisations.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently enthusiastic 5‑star feedback focuses on exceptional musical moments with no technical complaints, indicating an excellent show captured on a clean soundboard source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers make no negative comments about the audio; the tape is praised as preferable to other releases, implying clear and well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows organically with a heavy‑bass jam out of Truckin' that morphs into the first verse of The Other One, detours through Big River and Eyes before bursting back into Too and closing with a Wharf Rat coda.

band_member_comments.Bob: Weir's vocal phrasing and guitar work are highlighted during the Eyes jam and the final Wharf Rat coda.
